en.i1t: Five sessions, 39,093 kg on three lifting days
en.i1: Five sessions, 6h 08m, 39,093 kg, 3,326 active kcal — against five sessions and 39,240 kg the week before. Thursday’s hack squat day is the heaviest piece: 82 minutes, 19 sets, 200 reps, 16,185 kg, avg HR 116, max 154, 687 active kcal. Tuesday’s deadlift day ran 76 minutes, 18 sets, 246 reps, 11,388 kg, avg HR 123, max 155, 712 active kcal. Saturday’s front squat day added 11,520 kg over 84 minutes for 686 kcal. The two pool swims covered 2,200 m and 2,250 m in 64 and 62 minutes.
en.i2: Saturday’s front squat repeated Sep 5 exactly — 80 kg for 10 reps on all three working sets, 21 sets, 240 reps, 11,520 kg — the third session in a row anchored to 80 kg. It took 84 minutes against 81 on Sep 5, and avg HR came in at 116 against 111, with max 158 on both days: the same work at a slightly higher cardiac cost. Active burn was 686 kcal against 604. Zagreb air ran 11.8–22.3 °C.
en.i3t: Swim Sep 11: 2,250 m at 2:32 per 100 m
en.i3: Friday’s pool swim covered 2,250 m in 62 minutes as 500 + 8×200 + 100, averaging 2:32 per 100 m — six seconds off the 2:26 held on Aug 24 over the identical set. Avg HR 115 against 131 on Aug 24 and max 148 against 157: the pace came down with the effort, not against it. 580 active kcal, 25 strokes per minute over 90 lengths. Zagreb air ran 12.9–17.3 °C.
en.i4: Last night scored 89 on 6h 37m — the shortest of these seven nights and 43 minutes under the 7h 20m seven-night average, against a 28-day baseline of 7.1 h. HRV rose to 45, level with the seven-night mean and 2.2 above the 28-day baseline of 42.8. RHR held at 51, one under the seven-night mean of 52 and 2.2 under the 28-day baseline of 53.2. Ten minutes awake, the least of the seven. Readiness computes to 90.
en.rec: Tonnage over the last seven days is 39,093 kg across three lifting days, against 39,240 kg the week before, with the 28-day chronic load at 36,905 kg a week — an ACWR of 1.06. Nothing flags: the front squat top set repeated 80 kg × 10 on Sep 12 exactly as on Sep 5, and RHR at 51 sits 2.2 under its 28-day baseline of 53.2. Next session: barbell deadlift, 4 × 8 at 125 kg — 120 kg returned 10 reps on the top set on both Sep 1 and Sep 8. Sleep is the lever: last night’s 00:09 lights-out cut the night to 6h 37m after Friday’s 8h 44m. A deadlift day off a 6h 37m night is the one to protect — hold 22:15 tonight.

hr.i1t: Pet treninga, 39.093 kg u tri dana dizanja
hr.i1: Pet treninga, 6h 08m, 39.093 kg, 3.326 aktivnih kcal — naspram pet treninga i 39.240 kg tjedan prije. Četvrtkov dan hack čučnja najteži je komad: 82 minute, 19 serija, 200 ponavljanja, 16.185 kg, prosj. HR 116, max 154, 687 aktivnih kcal. Utorkov dan mrtvog dizanja trajao je 76 minuta, 18 serija, 246 ponavljanja, 11.388 kg, prosj. HR 123, max 155, 712 aktivnih kcal. Subotnji prednji čučanj dodao je 11.520 kg kroz 84 minute za 686 kcal. Dva plivanja u bazenu prešla su 2.200 m i 2.250 m u 64 i 62 minute.
hr.i2: Subotnji prednji čučanj ponovio je 5.9. do znamenke — 80 kg za 10 ponavljanja u sve tri radne serije, 21 serija, 240 ponavljanja, 11.520 kg — treći trening zaredom usidren na 80 kg. Trajao je 84 minute naspram 81 od 5.9., a prosj. HR bio je 116 naspram 111, uz max 158 oba dana: isti posao uz nešto veću srčanu cijenu. Aktivna potrošnja bila je 686 kcal naspram 604. Zrak u Zagrebu bio je 11,8–22,3 °C.
hr.i3: Petkovo plivanje u bazenu prešlo je 2.250 m u 62 minute kao 500 + 8×200 + 100, prosječno 2:32 na 100 m — šest sekundi iza 2:26 od 24.8. na istoj seriji. Prosj. HR 115 naspram 131 od 24.8. i max 148 naspram 157: tempo je pao zajedno s naporom, a ne protiv njega. 580 aktivnih kcal, 25 zaveslaja u minuti kroz 90 dužina. Zrak u Zagrebu bio je 12,9–17,3 °C.
hr.i4: Sinoć je ocjena bila 89 uz 6h 37m — najkraće od ovih sedam noći i 43 minute ispod sedmodnevnog prosjeka od 7h 20m, naspram 28-dnevne osnove od 7,1 h. HRV je narastao na 45, izjednačeno sa sedmodnevnim prosjekom i 2,2 iznad 28-dnevne osnove od 42,8. RHR je ostao na 51, jedan ispod sedmodnevnog prosjeka od 52 i 2,2 ispod 28-dnevne osnove od 53,2. Deset minuta budnosti, najmanje od sedam. Spremnost se računa na 90.
hr.rec: Tonaža u zadnjih sedam dana iznosi 39.093 kg kroz tri dana dizanja, naspram 39.240 kg tjedan prije, a 28-dnevno kronično opterećenje je 36.905 kg tjedno — ACWR 1,06. Nema zastavice: vršna serija prednjeg čučnja ponovila je 80 kg × 10 12.9. točno kao i 5.9., a RHR na 51 stoji 2,2 ispod svoje 28-dnevne osnove od 53,2. Sljedeći trening: mrtvo dizanje s šipkom, 4 × 8 na 125 kg — 120 kg dalo je 10 ponavljanja u vršnoj seriji i 1.9. i 8.9. Poluga je san: sinoćnje gašenje svjetla u 00:09 skratilo je noć na 6h 37m nakon petkovih 8h 44m. Dan mrtvog dizanja nakon noći od 6h 37m treba zaštititi — večeras drži 22:15.
